lines.zh: 神塔的石阶，我一天走三趟。
lines.en: Three trips a day up the tower's stone steps.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，好让来客跟上。
lines.en: I walk slowly so visitors can keep up.

lines.zh: 长袍扫过地面，声音很轻。
lines.en: My robe brushes the floor softly.

lines.zh: 这一层安静，适合讲道理。
lines.en: This floor is quiet; good for talking.

lines.zh: 我在廊柱之间转了个弯。
lines.en: I turn a corner between the pillars.

lines.zh: 脚步放轻，别惊了下面的人。
lines.en: Soft steps; do not startle those below.
Arms folded, I walk and watch the horizon.
The clouds sit lower than yesterday.
I follow the railing to its end.

lines.zh: 这里的地砖我记得每一块。
lines.en: I know every tile here by memory.
I head toward where the ki gathers.

lines.zh: 光从窗口斜进来，我眯了眼。
lines.en: Light slants through the window; I squint.

lines.zh: 走到台阶前，我先停一下。
lines.en: At the stair's edge, I pause first.

lines.zh: 这条路上，急的人总是先摔。
lines.en: On this path, the hurried ones fall first.

lines.zh: 没有来客的时候，我就看着云。
lines.en: With no visitors, I watch the clouds.

lines.zh: 我闭上眼，感受这里的气。
lines.en: I close my eyes and feel the ki here.
The wind lifts the curtain a little.
This staff has been with me a long while.
I wonder what to teach today.
The world below is always fighting.
I sit down cross-legged.

lines.zh: 呼吸一长一短，慢慢平了。
lines.en: Breath long, then short, then even.

lines.zh: 这些石头比我年纪还大。
lines.en: These stones are older than I am.

lines.zh: 没有人问问题，反而难熬。
lines.en: No one asking questions is its own hardship.
I open my palm and close it again.
Thunder far off, with no rain.
In the temple, I wait for your questions.
Someone should be coming up soon.
Your ki is unsteady.
You climbed up here with shaking legs.
I can tell you came with a question.
Breathe evenly first, then speak.

lines.zh: 你身上有打斗过的味道。
lines.en: You carry the smell of a fight.
Do not be nervous; I do not hit people.
Your wound has not fully healed.
Your ki has traveled a long way.
I am looking at your eyes.
You wish to become stronger, yes?
There is only you and me on this floor.
Lower your hands and relax.
You do not speak, so I wait.

lines.zh: 你站的位置踩到我的影子了。
lines.en: You are standing on my shadow.
You did not come here to fight.
Sit down; standing to talk is tiring.
I frown and make no sound.
This body was never made for blows.
It hurts, and I am still standing.
I press the wound and breathe slowly.
Stop; we can still talk.
This robe of mine is torn.
That landed heavier than I expected.
I retreat to the pillar.
The bleeding has stopped; only the ache remains.
You have a strong arm.
Water is all I need; keep the food.

lines.zh: 那点食物留给你自己吧。
lines.en: Keep that food for yourself.
Only water, and just a little.
You must be hungry; eat first, then we talk.
I am not used to that smell.
Water is enough, truly.
Put it away before you spill it.
There is no table for meals here.
Having someone cook for you is a good thing.
Go and eat; I will wait.
Ah, I am right here.
Slow down; the tiles are slick.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我差点掉了杖。
lines.en: You bumped me and I nearly dropped the staff.
No rush; I cannot run away from you.
Your shoulder is hard as stone.
Half a step apart and we are fine.
This corridor is narrow.
I did not mean to block the way.
Want to learn healing? Stand still first.
Push again and the curtain comes down.

lines.zh: 我这把年纪，早不谈这些。
lines.en: At my age, that is long past.

lines.zh: 那美克星人的事，和你想的不同。
lines.en: Namekian matters are not what you think.
I keep this tower alone.

lines.zh: 你的心思该用在修行上。
lines.en: Your mind belongs on training.
I have no answer for such things.
Sit; let us talk of something else.
I have something to keep watch over.
This is not mine to mind.

lines.zh: 你笑起来，我就不好说了。
lines.en: When you laugh, I lose my words.
Let us change the subject.
This fell at my feet.
Let me pick it up for you.
I stoop slowly; do not rush me.
Is it yours? Keep it safe.
There is ki in this bead.
Left there, someone will tread on it.
I wipe it on my sleeve.
You have dropped it twice now.
You have little enough; do not scatter it.
I hand it over; steady your hand.
You are guarding against me.
I feel your ki now.
No need for a stance.
Your fist is clenched too hard.
I watch you; do not watch me.

lines.zh: 我只是想知道你来做什么。
lines.en: I only want to know your purpose.

lines.zh: 想动手的话，我不会还手。
lines.en: If you strike, I will not strike back.
There are no enemies on this floor.
Your killing intent has faded.
Good; now we can talk.

lines.zh: 你的气散得厉害，我替你理。
lines.en: Your ki is scattered; let me steady it.
You have relaxed a little.
Your ki gathers at your hands.
Do not use that move here.
The stone will not take it.
I stand firm; you cannot move me.
If you must train, use the yard below.
I wait for your decision.
Your breathing has gone ragged again.
Sit, and we will talk it through.

lines.zh: 我不打人，这是我的规矩。
lines.en: I do not hit people; that is my rule.
Put that fist away.
Striking me will get you nowhere.
I will only take one step back.
I will pretend that did not happen.
It hurts, and I still will not strike.
My students hit far harder than that.
If you must fight, do it elsewhere.
I raise a hand to block, nothing more.
Again, and I still will not hit back.
I have been waiting in this tower.
Someone has come up; I raise my head.
The stairs here are long, are they not?

lines.zh: 我是丹迪，这里由我看守。
lines.en: I am Dende; I keep watch here.
You have found the right place.

lines.zh: 这座塔认得每一个来客。
lines.en: This tower knows every visitor.
I set the staff beside me.
Light settles on my shoulders.
Perhaps you are the one I have waited for.
Rest first; the road is still long.

lines.zh: 火焰扑过来，我的袍角焦了。
lines.en: Flames rush in and scorch my hem.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上滑下去，抓不住栏杆。
lines.en: I slide down the steps, missing the rail.

lines.zh: 水漫过头顶，我努力往上看。
lines.en: Water closes overhead; I strain to look up.
The blast slams me into the pillar.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在我身边的木柱。
lines.en: An arrow thuds into the post beside me.

lines.zh: 那股法术压得我膝盖发软。
lines.en: That spell buckles my knees.
Food was never what kept me alive.

lines.zh: 雷光顺着栏杆爬到我手上。
lines.en: Lightning crawls along the rail onto my hand.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我连杖一起坠落。
lines.en: The floor gives way and I fall with the staff.
